title: 时装世界节拍轮转｜同一成年角色跨风格、静默与英雄收束
source_title: 原宿糖朋克力量｜九段可爱时装爆切
summary: 同一明确成年时装角色以稳定脸、发型和比例贯穿多种风格世界；每段只改变服装、配饰、文字或舞台系统，并用一次静默留白后恢复全节拍，最终回到成熟英雄造型。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original fashion subject with at least three stable identity anchors. + Rotate distinct style modules while changing only declared wardrobe, accessory, palette and typography variables. + Bind every module to subject action, camera movement and foreground motion while preserving identity. + Insert one authored low-density pause after the maximum-intensity phase. + Return prior modules as a compressed recall and finish on the same adult in one stable hero frame.
recommended_input: 钴蓝工作室内锁定一名明确成年银发街头服装设计师，脸、短发和修长比例稳定；一枚超大透明搭扣擦过镜头后揭示她直视镜头。；先做三联身份核验，再进入深紫外模块，让少量原创短词在人物后方环绕；脸、发型和身体比例不变。；镜头穿过之前原创材质样本的拼贴，落到同一成年人的精致钴蓝英雄造型；只显示准确终局文字【MAKE IT YOURS】并停住。
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original fashion subject with at least three stable identity anchors.
Rotate distinct style modules while changing only declared wardrobe, accessory, palette and typography variables.
Insert one authored low-density pause after the maximum-intensity phase.
Return prior modules as a compressed recall and finish on the same adult in one stable hero frame.
